title: Accept 30001073: An explicit Frobenius corollary of established marginal entropy bounds for permanents
body:
## Accepted result and published preprint

**An explicit Frobenius corollary of established marginal entropy bounds for permanents**, Alec Kriebel. Published paper and verification package: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23430776 (https://zenodo.org/records/23430776).

Self-contained, credited corollary of Anari-Rezaei marginal entropy bounds, also implied by Anari (2026) and Dong-Jain (2026). For nonnegative row-stochastic A of order n>=1 and S=sum a_ij^2, per(A)<=exp(-n+e^4 S(1+log n)). Historical novelty and priority remain UNKNOWN. Extensive AI assistance; unrefereed; no external human peer review or formal proof-assistant certification.

## Accepted scope and review

For every nonnegative row-stochastic n×n A, per(A)≤exp(-n+e^4Σa_ij² log(e/a_ij))≤exp(-n+e^4 S(1+log n)). Fixed S≤γ yields polynomial-times-e^-n; source van der Waerden lower bound completes the doubly stochastic target.

No original asymptotic-target gap asserted. Pure-power bound is excluded at n=1; an all-n prefactor is supplied. Priority remains unresolved; Anari–Rezaei entropy inequality is credited, and scalar KL absorption/Frobenius consequence is the candidate contribution.

The result is accepted at the exact audited head `bdefe31b9d226c8f27008d13f57775d5de8df3d7`. 4 fresh independent complete AI whole-package reviews were completed, with the final review finding zero actionable issues. Subsequent bounded administrative adoption is recorded in the current external ROOT final seal; earlier status/counter/hold fields remain dated history. Prior mathematical results and proof dependencies are credited. Historical novelty and worldwide current openness are unestablished. AI tools were used extensively; this is an unrefereed preprint, without conventional human peer review or formal proof certification.

The repository Zenodo uploader verified the exact reviewed metadata and PDF/support bytes. The Google Workspace CLI recorded the DOI/details in the requested tracker with exact read-back. No GitHub release is created. Current audit and publication receipts: `audits/pr1064_30001073`.

## Mathematical result

**Complete accepted solution** of problem **30001073 / OWR-2090-026**, rank **1230**, on **Approach 1 of 5**. The independent analytic audit concludes PASS with no mathematical correction.

For every nonnegative row-stochastic n by n matrix A, with S=sum(a_ij²),

    per(A) ≤ exp(−n + e⁴ sum a_ij² log(e/a_ij))
           ≤ exp(−n + e⁴ S(1+log n)).

Zero summands use their continuous value. If S≤γ, then per(A)≤exp(e⁴γ)n^(e⁴γ)exp(−n) for every n≥1, and per(A)≤n^(3e⁴γ)exp(−n) for n≥2. The n=1 prefactor is necessary; a literal pure-power bound there is false. For the doubly stochastic source class, the already-known van der Waerden lower bound supplies the other direction. No stronger entrywise O(1/n) assumption is substituted.

The complete proof and substantive analytic audit retain the arbitrary-permutation entropy lemma, support and zero-entry treatment, Gibbs identity, total-mass KL bookkeeping, scalar absorption, Frobenius conversion, and block-diagonal example showing polynomial loss is necessary. The exponent is not claimed sharp.

## Attribution and limits

The original question is Alexander Barvinok and Alex Samorodnitsky's problem 9 in [Oberwolfach Report 44/2008](https://doi.org/10.4171/owr/2008/44), printed pages 2549–2550. The direct Gibbs-marginal/random-order comparison is credited to [Anari–Rezaei, arXiv:1811.02933v2](https://arxiv.org/abs/1811.02933v2), §4, equation (6), page 12; [Radhakrishnan's classical entropy method](https://doi.org/10.1006/jcta.1996.2727) and the prior lower bound remain attributed.

No novelty, historical-priority or sharp-constant claim is made. The work is AI-assisted and unrefereed. Independent analytic audit is not external human peer review or proof-assistant certification. Bounded source checks do not certify absence of a prior consequence.
